title: tdd-plan rewrite + green-gate verification
context: The tdd-plan CLI is a single 387-line bun script at pi/.local/bin/tdd-plan managing TDD plans as JSON in .pi/plans. Only the design command has test coverage. Logic is hard to unit-test because process.argv is parsed at module top level and process.exit is called throughout. Separately, jj does not run git hooks, so commits made during the GREEN phase get zero validation feedback until much later.
architecture: Entry pi/.local/bin/tdd-plan stays a thin dispatcher (argv to command, errors to exit codes). Modules under pi/.local/bin/lib/: types.ts, plan-io.ts (read write find archive), args.ts (parseArgs + flag helpers), steps.ts (text and JSON step parsing), render.ts (showPlan), commands.ts (cmdCreate cmdPhase etc exported and importable). New lib/verify.ts loadVerifyConfig(cwd) reads .pi/config.json verify array (absent or invalid returns empty), runVerify(commands) runs each via spawnSync with array args and short-circuits on first failure. The green-done path in cmdPhase calls the gate: pass writes plan plus exit 0, fail skips write and reprints output and exit 1, empty config skips with a warning. Config lives at .pi/config.json so it is portable and decoupled from mise.

design.currentState: Single-file bun CLI (387 lines). Only the design command is tested. Logic is not importable: process.argv parsed at module top level, process.exit scattered throughout, plus a statOrUndefined-via-require() hack. No verification runs on GREEN commits because jj bypasses git hooks entirely.
design.desiredState: Modular, importable CLI with broad test coverage. green-done atomically runs a configurable verify gate (lint-changed + typecheck) so the agent gets immediate pass-or-fail feedback, with a --no-verify escape hatch for sticky cases.
design.patterns: Characterize-before-refactor: lock current behavior with tests first, then move code under the safety net. spawnSync with array args (no shell escaping, works around Bun.escapeShellArg being undefined). Config-driven verification decoupled from mise for portability. Atomic state transitions: never persist the plan on failure.
design.decisions: Rewrite is structure + tests only, no CLI framework (keep hand-rolled arg parsing). Gate is strict + atomic at green done (Option A). Default command set excludes the full test suite since the step test already passed before green done. Config Option i: .pi/config.json read only by tdd-plan, git hook untouched and out of scope. Absent config = skip gate plus warn. Escape hatch = --no-verify flag on phase only, no env var. Verify commands run in order, short-circuit on first failure for fast focused feedback.
design.questions: Should refactor-done also gate as a follow-up? (explicitly out of v1). Confirm .pi/config.json over .pi/plans/config.json as the config path.
